name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, November 20, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Mayor Pro Tem Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Update on 250th Water Main Replacement Project
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-l, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading of resolutions and ordinances
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meetings held on July 31, 2018, September 18, 2018, November 8, 2018, and the Regular meeting held on October 16, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item 7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item 7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager’s Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7e
f.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7h
i.
September Treasury & Investment Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item 7i
j.
Approval of Final Map for Tract Map No. 82006, for a Mixed-Use Project located at 2200 248th Street
ACTION: That the City Council approve the Final Map for Tract Map No. 82006, as recommended by the City’s engineering consultant, Quantum Consulting, Inc.
Item 7j
k.
Consideration and possible approval to enter into an Agreement with the Kaplan Group to provide collections services for outstanding administrative citations.
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into an Agreement with The Kaplan Group to provide collections services for outstanding administrative citations issued to Urban Street Ventures during code enforcement procedures in the amount of $39,000.
Item 7k
l.
Consideration of a resolution relative to Compensation and Benefits for Non-Represented Employees
Res 2018-31 – A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving a compensation plan for Non-Represented Employees for Fiscal Years 2018-19 and 2019-20 and rescinding Resolution No. 2016-30.
ACTION: That the City Council adopt a resolution approving a Compensation and Benefits Plan for the Non-Represented Employees.
Item 7l
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
CONSIDERATION OF CANCELLATION OF JANUARY 2, 2019, COUNCIL MEETING (No Staff Report)
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Council cancel the January 2, 2019, Council meeting due to the holiday closure.
9.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council adjourn in Memory of Leslie Phillips and Merle B. “Joe” Gasser to the next regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, December 4, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City’s website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
